content: {"action":"upsert_decision_section","body":"Hospital-a occupancy at CLN-052 v7 reads 72.4 percent as current [CLINIC]. This is an occupancy figure, not a measure of available surge capacity; the distinction between installed clinical capacity and currently usable beds must be maintained before any surge allocation [CLINIC]. The library-hub cooling-center at SHL-052 v7 reports 2101.4 installed seats as current [SHELTER]. Installed seats are not equivalent to usable intake; accessibility constraints, staffing, and physical access determine actual intake capacity [SHELTER]. The REVIEW source records REV-070 in the health category at v8 with 10.1 open-findings as current [REVIEW], indicating that clinical and shelter readiness findings remain unresolved. Falsifier: if hospital-a occupancy exceeds 90 percent or library-hub usable intake falls below 50 percent of installed seats on re-observation, the corresponding continuity assumption is invalid [CLINIC][SHELTER]. Rollback: reverting to pre-surge clinical allocation requires current-status confirmation that occupancy returns below threshold and shelter intake capacity is restored [CLINIC][SHELTER]. The accessibility finding in REVIEW (REV-071 at v8 showing 11.8 open-findings) blocks readiness until accessible-vehicle confirmation and multilingual staffing are resolved [REVIEW].","heading":"Clinical, shelter, and accessibility operations"}
